wembley.s1_head: Kitting the events district of Wembley
s1loc: Wembley is the UK's biggest events district. Wembley Stadium hosts the marquee stadium concerts and finals, the OVO Arena Wembley, the former SSE Arena, runs more than a hundred shows a year next door, and the wider Wembley Park drives a near-constant calendar of gigs, screenings and pop-ups around BOXPARK Wembley and the London Designer Outlet. Few places in the country turn over crews on this scale, week in and week out across the year.

And the trade runs at every size. The big stadium and arena operators, festival promoters and production companies field large seasonal crews and buy through procurement, while independent event crews, riggers and promoters around Wembley Park and the wider northwest of London want just a handful of branded pieces. A workwear supplier here has to serve the stadium show and the single crew alike, which is why we run trade accounts and direct online ordering side by side.
